title: DeepSeek-V3.1
venue: Official DeepSeek Hugging Face model release
best_for_zh: 审计版本化发布的披露边界
one_line: DeepSeek-V3.1 releases weights, interface formats, 128K context, and base-extension token counts, but not its post-training data, feedback, or audit stack.
DeepSeek-V3.1 发布了权重、接口、128K 上下文和基础延长 token 数，但未公开后训练数据、反馈或审计栈。
why: It separates a usable model release from the missing evidence required to audit how reasoning and tool use were post-trained.
inclusion_reason: A versioned frontier release that quantifies long-context extension while leaving its post-training data and feedback stack opaque.

title: Problem
问题
html: A versioned model release can make a checkpoint operationally reusable without making its reasoning-data lineage auditable. DeepSeek-V3.1 publishes weights, runtime formats, thinking/non-thinking templates, and tool interfaces, but has no dedicated technical report. The central task is therefore to record the release facts precisely while refusing to infer its post-training recipe from the earlier DeepSeek-V3 report.
版本化模型发布可以让检查点具备实际可用性，却不一定让推理数据血缘可审计。DeepSeek-V3.1 发布了权重、运行格式、思考/非思考模板和工具接口，但没有专门技术报告。因此，本卡的核心任务是准确记录发布事实，同时拒绝从更早的 DeepSeek-V3 报告反推 V3.1 的后训练配方。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: DeepSeek-V3.1 is an official 671B-total/37B-activated, 128K-context release that exposes two behaviors through the chat template: a think prefix enables thinking mode, whereas a closing think marker selects non-thinking mode. Its base checkpoint extends the original V3 base with additional long documents over 630B tokens at 32K and 209B tokens at 128K. The release also specifies non-thinking tool calls and thinking-mode search-agent trajectories. It states that post-training optimization improved tool and agent performance, but discloses no corresponding prompts, traces, rewards, or optimizer.

DeepSeek-V3.1 是官方发布的 671B 总参数、37B 激活参数、128K 上下文模型，通过聊天模板暴露两种行为：思考前缀启用 thinking mode，结束思考标记选择 non-thinking mode。其基础检查点在原始 V3 Base 上加入额外长文档，分别以 630B token 完成 32K 扩展、以 209B token 完成 128K 扩展。发布页还规定了非思考模式的工具调用格式和思考模式的搜索代理轨迹。官方称后训练优化提升了工具与代理能力，但没有披露对应提示、轨迹、奖励或优化器。

title: Method
方法
html:
The only disclosed training lineage is V3 Base to V3.1-Base to V3.1. V3.1-Base follows the earlier two-phase context-extension method, but expands the data with unspecified additional long documents and lengthens the 32K and 128K phases to 630B and 209B tokens. The release uses UE8M0 FP8 scaling for weights and activations. It then says V3.1 is post-trained on V3.1-Base, without naming stages, teachers, filters, rewards, sampling, or environments.

At inference, first-turn and multi-turn prefixes control thinking mode. Previous-turn thinking content is dropped from multi-turn context while the closing think marker remains. Non-thinking tool calls use a strict schema containing exact tool names and JSON arguments. Thinking-mode search agents use separate multi-turn templates for user-provided search and Python tools. These formats define observable records and runtime contracts; they are not evidence that the same templates, tools, or success predicates were used during training.

唯一明确披露的训练血缘是 V3 Base 到 V3.1-Base，再到 V3.1。V3.1-Base 沿用早期的两阶段上下文扩展方法，但加入来源未说明的额外长文档，并把 32K 与 128K 阶段分别延长到 630B 和 209B token。发布版本对权重和激活采用 UE8M0 FP8 缩放格式。此后，官方只说明 V3.1 在 V3.1-Base 上完成后训练，并未列出训练阶段、教师、过滤、奖励、采样或环境。

推理时，首轮与多轮前缀控制思考模式。多轮上下文会移除前一轮的思考内容，但保留结束标记。非思考工具调用采用严格格式，要求工具名精确匹配且参数是符合 schema 的 JSON。思考模式的搜索代理则使用独立的多轮模板，调用用户提供的搜索与 Python 工具。这些格式定义了可观察记录和运行时契约，但不能证明训练时使用了相同模板、工具或成功条件。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The official Hugging Face model card directly supports the checkpoint lineage, parameter counts, 128K context, extension-token counts, UE8M0 format, chat prefixes, tool-call schema, search-agent examples, and MIT licensing. It also reports benchmark results for thinking, non-thinking, code, and search-agent settings. Those evaluations support the release's behavior claims under its stated protocols; they do not reveal the construction or quality of the hidden post-training data. The linked DeepSeek-V3 repository supports runtime implementation for the shared architecture, not a V3.1-specific training recipe.

官方 Hugging Face 模型卡直接支持检查点血缘、参数规模、128K 上下文、扩展 token 数、UE8M0 格式、聊天前缀、工具调用 schema、搜索代理示例和 MIT 许可。发布页还报告了思考、非思考、代码和搜索代理设置下的基准结果。这些评测只支持模型在所述协议下的行为主张，并不揭示隐藏后训练数据的构造或质量。链接的 DeepSeek-V3 仓库支持共享架构的运行实现，而不是 V3.1 专属训练配方。

title: Novelty
新意
html: For the atlas, the notable contribution is the interface-level unification of thinking, direct answering, structured tool calls, and multi-turn search within one released checkpoint. The release also quantifies its base-model context extension rather than merely claiming 128K support. Its value is therefore a precise versioned disclosure of artifacts and behavior contracts—not a new evidenced post-training method.
对本图谱而言，值得记录的贡献是：同一已发布检查点通过接口统一支持思考、直接回答、结构化工具调用和多轮搜索。发布页还量化了基础模型的上下文扩展，而不是只宣称支持 128K。因此，其价值在于对版本化工件与行为契约的精确披露，而不是一项已有证据支持的新后训练方法。

title: Limitations
局限
html: There is no dedicated V3.1 paper. The release does not disclose the sources, licenses, filters, mixture, split, or decontamination of the added long documents. More importantly, it provides no post-training prompt inventory, trace examples, teacher or generator identity, reward/verifier contract, environment, preference records, rollout count, sampling settings, optimizer, compute, rejection log, or item-level lineage. The earlier V3 report cannot fill these fields because V3.1 is a later checkpoint with an explicitly separate but undocumented post-training stage. Tool syntax and search trajectories define inference use, not training provenance.

V3.1 没有专门论文。发布页未披露新增长文档的来源、许可、过滤、比例、划分或去污染。更关键的是，它没有提供后训练提示清单、轨迹样例、教师或生成器身份、奖励/验证契约、环境、偏好记录、rollout 数量、采样设置、优化器、算力、拒绝日志或逐条血缘。较早的 V3 报告不能填补这些字段，因为 V3.1 是更晚的检查点，并明确经历了独立但未记录的后训练阶段。工具语法和搜索轨迹规定的是推理用法，而不是训练来源。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this release Card to distinguish four evidence layers: base-extension data scale, downloadable weights, inference templates, and undisclosed post-training. It is a useful reference for systems that must reproduce V3.1 prompt formatting or compare thinking and non-thinking interfaces. For data research, its main value is negative but important: it shows exactly why open weights and detailed tool syntax are insufficient to audit agent-training data or feedback.
本发布卡可用于区分四个证据层：基础扩展数据规模、可下载权重、推理模板，以及未披露的后训练。它适合需要复现 V3.1 提示格式，或比较思考与非思考接口的系统研究。对数据研究而言，其主要价值虽是“缺失披露”，但很重要：它明确展示了为何开放权重和详细工具语法仍不足以审计代理训练数据与反馈。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Treat the Hugging Face page as the primary V3.1 release record; there is no dedicated V3.1 technical report in the verified sources.
  • Keep 630B/209B long-context extension tokens separate from unknown post-training data.
  • Read the chat-template section for thinking, non-thinking, tool-call, and search-agent runtime contracts.
  • Do not transfer R1 distillation, GRPO, or reward details from the earlier V3 report to V3.1.

• 应把 Hugging Face 页面视为 V3.1 的主要发布记录；已核验来源中没有 V3.1 专属技术报告。
  • 630B/209B 长上下文扩展 token 必须与未知的后训练数据分开记录。
  • 聊天模板部分规定了思考、非思考、工具调用和搜索代理的运行时契约。
  • 不得把早期 V3 报告中的 R1 蒸馏、GRPO 或奖励细节迁移到 V3.1。

title: Citation
引用
html:
No dedicated DeepSeek-V3.1 paper or release-specific BibTeX is provided in the official model card. Provisional release citation:

DeepSeek-AI. DeepSeek-V3.1. Official model release, 2025. https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3.1

The BibTeX displayed on that page cites the earlier DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report (arXiv:2412.19437) and should not be used as evidence of a V3.1 paper.

官方模型卡没有提供 DeepSeek-V3.1 专属论文或发布版 BibTeX。暂定发布引用：

DeepSeek-AI. DeepSeek-V3.1. 官方模型发布，2025。https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3.1

该页面展示的 BibTeX 实际引用较早的《DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report》（arXiv:2412.19437），不应据此声称存在 V3.1 论文。
